meals.name: Creamy Tomato Gnocchi with Burrata
ings: 6–8 garlic cloves, peeled and lightly crushed
1 tsp kosher salt, ½ tsp black pepper
steps: Bring large pot of salted water to boil. Heat olive oil in skillet over medium-low. Cook garlic until fragrant, ~2 min.
Increase to medium; add tomatoes. Cook until most break down and become jammy, 10–12 min. Season. Reduce and stir in cream.
Cook gnocchi per package. Reserve ½ cup pasta water, drain the rest.
Add gnocchi and pasta water to sauce. Toss until thick and glossy, ~2 min. Stir in basil.
Break burrata over pasta. Remove from heat. Garnish with reserved basil.
meals.note: 💡 Add burrata after removing from heat — don't cook it or it loses its creamy texture.
meals.label: Meal A

meals.name: Bang Bang Ground Turkey Rice Bowls
steps: Begin by cooking jasmine rice according to package instructions, so it is ready and warm when needed.
In a small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, sriracha sauce, and lime juice to create the bang bang sauce. Set it aside.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the olive oil.
Add the ground turkey to the skillet, breaking it apart with a spoon, and cook until browned.
Once the turkey is cooked through, add the soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.
Add the chopped red bell pepper, carrots, and broccoli to the skillet, cooking for another 5-7 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Remove the skillet from the heat and mix in half of the bang bang sauce, ensuring everything is well coated.
To serve, place a mound of cooked jasmine rice into individual bowls.
Top the rice with the turkey and vegetable mixture.
Drizzle the remaining bang bang sauce over each bowl.
Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds for added flavor and texture.
Serve immediately and enjoy!
meals.label: Meal B

meals.name: Turkey Burgers
steps: 1. Mixing the Ingredients:

In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground turkey, breadcrumbs, chopped onion, minced garlic, egg, Worcestershire sauce, salt, black pepper, and paprika (if you’re using it). Mix everything together gently until it’s just combined. Be careful not to overmix, or your burgers may become tough!
2. Shaping the Patties:
Next, divide the turkey mixture into four equal parts. Shape each part into a patty that’s about 3/4 inch thick. This size will help them cook evenly—no one wants an undercooked burger!
3. Cooking the Patties:

Now, preheat your grill or skillet over medium-high heat. If you’re using a skillet, lightly grease it with a bit of oil to prevent sticking. Cook the turkey patties for about 5-6 minutes on each side. You want them nicely browned and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C). Use a meat thermometer if you have one!
Ezoic
4. Toasting the Buns:
While the burgers are cooking, you can toast the sesame seed buns. Pop them on the grill or use a toaster for a few minutes until they are golden and warm. This adds just a bit of crunch!
5. Assembling the Burgers:

Once your turkey patties are cooked, it’s time to assemble your burgers! Place a cooked patty on the bottom half of a bun. Top it with a lovely layer of lettuce, some pickles, and a few slices of red onion—whatever you like best! Don’t forget your favorite condiments, then place the top half of the bun over everything.
6. Serve and Enjoy!
Serve your turkey burgers immediately while they’re hot and juicy. Enjoy them with your favorite sides or just on their own. Yum!
meals.label: Meal C

meals.name: Chicken Sausages with Zucchini, Tomatoes, and Pasta
ings: 8 ounces of penne or fusilli pasta
steps: Begin by cooking the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add the sliced chicken sausages and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, cooking for an additional minute until fragrant. Be careful not to burn the garlic.
Add the sliced zucchinis and continue to cook until slightly softened, about 4-5 minutes.
Stir in the halved cherry tomatoes, season with Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook until the tomatoes start to soften and release their juices, around 3 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low, and gently fold in the cooked pasta with the sausage and vegetable mixture.
Add the grated Parmesan cheese, tossing to ensure everything is well combined and the cheese has melted into the pasta.
Serve the dish warm, garnished with fresh basil leaves for added flavor and a pop of color.
